visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman sits on a light grey couch with two young children, a boy and a girl. They are gathered around a white, house-shaped electronic device placed on the sofa cushion. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting an indoor living room or studio set. (2) The woman holds the device toward the camera, speaking directly to the viewer. She is wearing a cream-colored dress. The background remains the same neutral couch setting. (3) The camera focuses on a smartphone screen showing the 'kokozi' app, with hands scrolling through various colorful icons representing children's stories and songs. (4) The boy is shown alone on the couch, listening intently to the device. An animated white rabbit holding a carrot is overlaid next to him. (5) The girl is shown operating the device by placing a small character figure inside and turning a knob on the top. (6) Both children are at a low table drawing in coloring books while the device sits nearby, providing audio content. (7) Short clips show the kids in car seats using the device during travel, followed by a dark room scene where the girl is asleep and the device emits a soft yellow glow. (8) The woman is shown reading a book and recording her voice into her phone. (9) The video concludes with the two children dancing excitedly in a hallway with the device placed on the floor between them.
